highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled engine to Skia m151 and delivers a significant managed-layer performance pass.
highlights_body: Hot paths across color conversion, SKColor hex parsing, HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffering and SKShaper glyph reading shed allocations and P/Invoke round-trips. WASM gets .NET 11 / Emscripten 5.0.6 support, and a CPU raster regression introduced in the preview line is corrected.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances to Chrome milestone 151, with multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges folded in throughout the preview cycle.
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT, which was accidentally dropped in an upstream sync and caused a CPU raster rendering regression.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads
bullets.detail: The hex-color parser is rewritten to parse directly from a span, avoiding intermediate string allocations, and new `ReadOnlySpan<char>` overloads are added.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData with crop rect
bullets.detail: The `SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI)` overload now releases the encoded data handle when decoding fails, closing a native resource leak.

SKColor-to-SKColorF and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are ported to integer math in managed C#, eliminating P/Invoke round-trips. SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 becomes allocation-free using a pooled UTF-8 encoder, and per-call char[4] allocations in HBTag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse are eliminated.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static library slices (with new exnref exception handling) and a preview-.NET WASM test job so exception-handling regressions are caught early.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Cleaned up the WebAssembly Skia build by removing the redundant SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM define upstream

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update and the WebAssembly build cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the bulk of the performance pass — managed SKColor/SKPMColor math, SKShaper zero-copy spans, allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 buffering, and the SKColor hex parsing overhaul — plus the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM slices and upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate landed the CPU raster regression fix (SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT), the native resource leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData, the preview-.NET WASM test job, and additional upstream m151 stability fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Carries HarfBuzz 14.2.1 with allocation-free UTF-8 buffering in Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminated per-call allocations in HBTag.Parse.
